notes: Squeek (SQK) is an ERC-20 token with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the deploying factory at launch. It exposes no administrative powers or further minting and uses ordinary ERC-20 transfers without fees. No application contracts are included. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
